english.title: Trespass with an imitation firearm on land
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while having with you an imitation firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IMITATION FIREARM..), entered or were on land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), as a trespasser and without reasonable excuse
english.legislation: Contrary to section20(2) of, and Schedule6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) 'Imitation firearm' was added by section 2(1) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1994.
(ii) See also offence wordings H485, H500 and H501.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iv) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.
